privacy.title: Privacy.
privacy.lede: Trophy XI is designed to work without requiring a user account for normal gameplay.
privacy.progressDescription: Trophy XI may store game and preference state in your browser’s local storage so a session can survive navigation or a refresh. This information stays in the browser unless another feature explicitly sends it elsewhere.
privacy.analyticsDescription: The site uses Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to understand site usage and performance. Those services may process technical usage information according to Vercel’s own privacy practices.
privacy.changesDescription: This page should be updated if Trophy XI later adds accounts, advertising, payments, user uploads, or other features that materially change what data is collected or processed.

engineering.metadataDescription: The math and computer science behind Trophy XI: team modeling, era translation, seeded simulation, match state, testing and delivery.

hero.description: A great XI is more than eleven high rated cards. Position, chemistry, manager, era, bench depth and the current match state all change what the team can actually do.
hero.seedDescription: The simulator stays unpredictable without becoming impossible to test. Same inputs. Same seed. Same result.

teamModel.title: A TEAM IS A SYSTEM, NOT A SUM.
teamModel.description: Tournament quality is the starting point. Then the engine looks at where the player is used, how the lineup fits together, who manages it, the era around it and what is still available on the bench.

position.title: A GREAT PLAYER IN THE WRONG ROLE SHOULD COST YOU.
position.description: Squad building is a constraint problem. Maximize quality, but keep the lineup coherent. Force a player into the wrong role and less of that quality is actually usable.

era.title: 1970 → 2026 IS NOT THE SAME PROBLEM AS 2026 → 1970.
era.description: Era is treated as an environment change, not a permanent advantage for modern football or older legends. The direction of the translation matters.

manager.title: CHANGE THE MANAGER. CHANGE THE TEAM.
manager.description: Offense, defense, tactics and game management change how the same group of players behaves before and during the match.

matchEngine.title: RANDOM, BUT REPRODUCIBLE.
matchEngine.description: Football needs variance. The simulator still needs to be debuggable. A seed gives the engine both.
matchEngine.order: football inputs first, seeded randomness after

matchState.title: THE NEXT EVENT DEPENDS ON WHAT IS TRUE RIGHT NOW.
matchState.description: The match is not decided at kickoff. Score, minute, shots, xG, cards, fatigue and substitutions keep changing the next decision. Each event updates the state, then the engine evaluates the next one.
matchState.quote: A stronger side can move the probabilities. It never gets promised a win.

bench.title: THE BENCH CHANGES WITH THE MATCH.
bench.description: The right substitute at 0–0 is not automatically the right substitute at 1–0 or 0–1. Time, fatigue, fit, manager behavior and score change what the next substitution needs to solve.

testing.title: IF THE MODEL CHANGES, THE TESTS SHOULD CATCH IT.
testing.description: Reproducible simulation makes bugs easier to isolate. Historical data is validated before it reaches the game, with Vitest and Playwright covering simulation, tournament progression and integrity paths.

simulation.label: SIMULATION
simulation.title: SEEDED
simulation.description: Same inputs can reproduce the same path when a regression needs to be isolated.

data.label: DATA
data.title: VALIDATED
data.description: Duplicate identities, unsupported records and asset mismatches are caught before release.

product.label: PRODUCT
product.title: 40+ TEST FILES
product.description: Vitest and Playwright cover the engine, progression and product integrity.

delivery.title: FAST MATH STILL NEEDS A FAST PRODUCT.
delivery.description: The game runs in Next.js and TypeScript. Player assets are delivered through S3 and CloudFront, with Vercel and Cloudflare handling the product around the simulator.

idea.title: BUILD THE BETTER XI. GET THE BETTER CHANCE. NOT A GUARANTEED WIN.
idea.description: If the best team wins every time, it stops feeling like football. If the choices barely matter, the draft means nothing. Trophy XI has to live between those two.

decisions.title: DECISIONS MATTER
decisions.description: Draft, roles, manager, era and bench all have to move the match.

upsets.title: UPSETS STAY ALIVE
upsets.description: Great teams lose. Underdogs steal games. That is part of football.

results.title: RESULTS CAN BE REPLAYED
results.description: Every seed can be rerun, so a weird result can be traced instead of guessed at.

final.title: BUILD AN XI.
final.description: Then see if the model agrees with you.
